verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments infrastructure SaaS. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code availability, a public repository, or an open-source license. The docs, MCP server and llms.txt cover documentation access, not source openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
